label: channel()
type: the sync-function helper that routes/assigns a document to one or more channels. A channel comes into existence implicitly the first time a document is routed to it - there is no separate creation step. Like access(), its effect is provisional: it only takes hold if the sync function goes on to accept the document revision (does not throw()).
note: Pairs with access() as the two 'mutate the access graph' helpers, as against the require*()/throw() family that gates the write itself.
